country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_DDR.2
	title = COLDWAR_DDR.2.t
	desc = COLDWAR_DDR.2.d
	picture = GFX_politics_negotiations

	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DDR.2"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DDR.2.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
		}
		add_power_balance_value = {
			id = COLDWAR_DDR_german_course_bop
			value = 0.05
			tooltip_side = COLDWAR_DDR_german_course_bop_right_side
		}
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_course = 0.05 } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_DDR_course min = -1 max = 1 } }
		add_stability = -0.02
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DDR.2.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 70
		}
		add_power_balance_value = {
			id = COLDWAR_DDR_german_course_bop
			value = -0.05
			tooltip_side = COLDWAR_DDR_german_course_bop_left_side
		}
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_course = -0.05 } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_DDR_course min = -1 max = 1 } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_trust_plus_2_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta = 2 } COLDWAR_DDR_change_trust = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = 5 }
		change_intelligence_community_opinion = yes
	}
}

	title = COLDWAR_DDR.22.t
	desc = COLDWAR_DDR.22.d
	picture = GFX_marketplace

	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = DDR
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_initialized
		date > 1977.6.1
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		days = 1
	}

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DDR.22"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DDR.22.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
		}
		add_stability = -0.03
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DDR.22.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.005 } }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		add_stability = -0.01
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_DDR.23
	title = COLDWAR_DDR.23.t
	desc = COLDWAR_DDR.23.d
	picture = GFX_news_refinery_industry

	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = DDR
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_initialized
		date > 1981.10.1
		is_subject_of = SOV
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		days = 1
	}

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DDR.23"
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_oil_cut
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DDR.23.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
		}
		if = { limit = { COLDWAR_DDR_ladder_lignite_active = yes } COLDWAR_DDR_ladder_lignite_clear = yes add_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_energy_coal_instead_of_oil }
		add_stability = -0.02
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DDR.23.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.01 } }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_trust_minus_2_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta = -2 } COLDWAR_DDR_change_trust = yes }
	}
}

		reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = FROM modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_solidarity_partner }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_gdr_hospital } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_DDR_gdr_hospital days = 365 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_gdr_trained_security } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_DDR_gdr_trained_security days = 730 } }
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.900 days = 1 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DDR.164.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 15
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DDR.164 option b"
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.901 days = 1 } }

# COLDWAR | offer COLDWAR_DDR_offer_mozambique
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_DDR.165
	title = COLDWAR_DDR.165.t
	desc = COLDWAR_DDR.165.d
	picture = GFX_african_meeting

	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DDR.165.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 80
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_war_with = FROM }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_government = communism }
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 has_opinion = { target = FROM value < 0 } }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DDR.165 option a"
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = FROM modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_solidarity_partner }
		reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = FROM modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_solidarity_partner }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_gdr_trucks_and_machinery } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_DDR_gdr_trucks_and_machinery days = 1095 } }
		FROM = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_sol_contract_workers }
				swap_ideas = {
					remove_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_sol_contract_workers
					add_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_sol_contract_worker_programme
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_sol_contract_worker_programme } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_sol_contract_workers }
		}
		FROM = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_DDR_planned_economy_modifier }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_planned_economy_energy_gain_multiplier = 0.03 tooltip = energy_gain_multiplier_tt }
			newline = yes
		}
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.900 days = 1 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DDR.165.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DDR.165 option b"
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.901 days = 1 } }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_DDR.168
	title = COLDWAR_DDR.168.t
	desc = COLDWAR_DDR.168.d
	picture = GFX_weapons_arms1

	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DDR.168.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 55
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_war_with = FROM }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_government = communism }
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 has_opinion = { target = FROM value < 0 } }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DDR.168 option a"
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_gdr_arms_deliveries } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_DDR_gdr_arms_deliveries days = 730 } }
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = FROM modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_trading_partner }
		reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = FROM modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_trading_partner }
		FROM = {
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = 0.003 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.63 days = 365 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.63 days = 730 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_arms_for_oil_tt
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.900 days = 1 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DDR.168.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 45
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DDR.168 option b"
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.901 days = 1 } }
	}
}
